dedupe_keys.name: great britain wastewater catchment processing workflow

description: This repository contains code for consolidating wastewater catchment boundaries across Great Britain and joining them to treatment works, small-area geography and estimated population. Its authors use information-request responses from sewerage providers and European treatment-plant reports, then publish scripts for matching catchments and calculating spatial overlaps. Inputs are provider polygons, treatment-works tables and population areas; outputs include catchment identifiers, plant lookups and overlap or population tables. The documented treatment metadata span 2006–2018, while coverage is Great Britain and geometry is mapped in British National Grid. The processing code is free under MIT; the repository's release notice explicitly says this licence does not cover the underlying catchment data, whose copyright remains with each water company. A limitation is that overlaps, unmatched works and mixed reporting vintages can affect a local service-area estimate. The workflow can prepare demand and exposure inputs for sewer-network simulations. The catalogue's model-epanet is a separate hydraulic network model for comparison; no direct export was tested. No shapefile was downloaded.
name: Great Britain wastewater-catchment processing workflow
